usage.outputShape: Intended: body.risk_score (0-100), body.flags[], body report with liquidity + top-holder data. Actual: 404 {detail} only — no result produced.
quirks: Charge-then-404: charges $0.01 USDC then returns HTTP 404 even for valid tokens.

Both USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) and BRETT (0x532f27101965dd16442E59d40670FaF5eBB142E4) on Base returned 404 {detail: 'No security data found for this token. It may not exist on this chain.'}.
A major token like USDC should always resolve in any real rug-pull/security dataset — the backend dataset appears empty or broken.
token_address is a path segment; you must substitute a real ERC-20 address, no body needed.
usage.guide: This endpoint is broken — it accepts x402 payment then returns HTTP 404 'No security data found for this token' for every token tested, including USDC on Base which should always resolve. Do not call it; you will lose ~$0.01 USDC per call with no result. If retried in future, the intended usage is GET .../analyze/{token_address} substituting a real ERC-20 address (no body), reading body.risk_score and body.flags[].
